rules.title: San Francisco ban on algorithm-based rent-setting tools
rules.requirement: Property owners and managers may not use algorithm-based tools that recommend or set rental prices.
rules.coverage_conditions: Residential property owners and managers in San Francisco (details not stated in this document).
rules.citation: San Francisco ordinance (citation not given in this document)
rules.quoted_span:
In July 2024, the San Francisco Board of Supervisors approved 
legislation to ban property owners and managers from using algorithm-based tools that recommend 
or set rental prices.
rules.conflict_note: Secondary mention in a Los Angeles council motion; no citation, effective date, or coverage details given. Board approval in July 2024 implies likely in force by 2026-10-01, but final adoption/effective date not confirmed by this document.

rules.title: Los Angeles motion to study ban on algorithm-based rent-setting software
rules.requirement: Motion instructs the Los Angeles Housing Department to report on landlords' use of algorithm-based rent-setting software and the feasibility of banning such software in the City; it does not itself impose a ban.
rules.coverage_conditions: Ownership and management entities in the City of Los Angeles using algorithm-based software to set rents (proposed study scope).
rules.citation: Los Angeles City Council File 24-1031 (Motion, Sept. 3, 2024)
rules.quoted_span:
I THEREFORE MOVE that the City Council instruct the Los Angeles Housing Department to 
report on the number of ownership and management entities that are using algorithm-based 
software to establish rents and the feasibility of instituting a ban on the use of this software to set 
rents in the City.
rules.conflict_note: This is only a motion requesting a feasibility report, not an ordinance; no binding rule created. Subsequent action, if any, is not reflected in this document.
